critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/visitors_reg.py list_visitors uses raw user input in $regex (name/document) without re.escape — minor ReDoS/injection surface. registry.py uses re.escape via rx(); keep consistent.

registry._save sets current_area_id to 'Externa Pedestre' for ALL new people including terceiros using veículos/caminhões categories. Same seed/engine mismatch raised in iteration 2 can propagate — ensure new terceiros 'veículo'/'caminhão' categories pick the matching external area, or the engine's control_origin logic must accept any is_exterior as compatible with external origins.
backend/photo_quality.py loads CascadeClassifier at import time; keep in mind cold-start cost and that cascade may fail silently if haarcascade file missing — ok today, but add a startup smoke check.
Permissions-Policy middleware is attached after CORS middleware; works but note the ordering — Starlette runs middleware in reverse of add order. Current result is correct per test, keep as-is.
PersonForm.jsx is 234 lines and already near the 'split-into-modules' threshold. Future growth should pull FormHeader & save() hook into separate files.

/registry/people list endpoint returns photo_thumb (good) but LIST_FIELDS excludes 'photo' only — large base64 photos never leak; keep. However /registry/people/{id} returns full 'photo' — acceptable for edit flow but adds 100–200KB per fetch; consider lazy-loading via a dedicated /photo endpoint.

Visit _iso() silently returns the original string on empty/with +/Z, but accepts naïve local 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM'. If a client ever passes seconds (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) it will still parse (fromisoformat ok). Add an explicit validation to reject malformed inputs with 422.

success_rate.backend: 100% (34/34 registry+visitors; 23/23 access_model + 12/12 engine from prior iters still green)
